corrected_source_files.changes: Added arm_id, algorithm_version, telemetry_collection_latency_ms, llm_latency_ms, total_elapsed_ms fields to ExperimentRun model.

Implemented explicit arm selection and validation (AUTHORIZED_ARMS), CESOService integration for ARM_5_CESO_CADE_NO_LLM, high-resolution multi-component timing, and removed hardcoded sc_id == CASE_04 escalation leak.
Added diagnose_rule_based() implementation for ARM_3_RULE_BASED (algorithm_version=1.0.0-arm3-rule-based) while preserving frozen Phase 2 baseline diagnose_state() (algorithm_version=2.0.0-phase2).
Updated CSV summary exporter to include arm_id, algorithm_version, telemetry_collection_latency_ms, and total_elapsed_ms.
Created dedicated unit test suite covering arm dispatch, algorithmic distinction, Phase 2 baseline preservation, CESO invocation, ground-truth isolation, and timing instrumentation.

corrected_defects.title: Missing Arm Dispatcher
corrected_defects.resolution: Implemented explicit arm_id parameter in BenchmarkRunner with AUTHORIZED_ARMS validation failing closed on blocked or unimplemented arms.

corrected_defects.title: Functional Identity of Arms 3 & 4
corrected_defects.resolution: Implemented standalone diagnose_rule_based() in ExplainableRuleEngine for Arm 3, demonstrating explicit discrete boolean rule matching distinct from continuous CADE scoring.

corrected_defects.title: Ground-Truth Control Flow Leak
corrected_defects.resolution: Removed sc_id == CASE_04 hardcoded check from runner.py. Escalation now depends strictly on cadd_diag.escalation_required.

corrected_defects.title: Bypassed Telemetry Service in Arm 5
corrected_defects.resolution: Connected Arm 5 to ceso_service.load_scenario(sc_id) for dynamic telemetry collection.

corrected_defects.title: Defective Latency Instrumentation
corrected_defects.resolution: Replaced single latency measurement with bounded high-resolution timers for telemetry collection, CADE diagnosis, LLM inference, and total elapsed duration.
